research.facts:
Jadelyn Allchin — AUSL Championship Series MVP
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Utah Talons swept Chicago Bandits 2-0 to win 2026 AUSL Championship
- Game 1 (July 25): Utah 2, Chicago 1 — Georgina Corrick CG
- Game 2 (July 26): Utah 6, Chicago 1 — Montana Fouts CG (7 IP, 8H, 1R, 4K)
- Jadelyn Allchin named Championship Series MVP
- Allchin Game 2: two-run HR to right field in top of 1st inning; RBI double in 4th inning; 3 RBI in Game 2
- Allchin drove in 6 of Utah's 8 total runs across the two-game series
- Allchin quote: "The whole series, I think we woke up and we were just ready to go... the big thing that I thought today was like heart. I think we brought a lot of heart to the past two games. Knowing that showing up with heart for ourselves, for our teammates, like showing up for the game in general, is what I think got us through it all."
- UCLA Athletics published story July 27, 2026: "Five Former Players Win AUSL Championship With Talons"
- Allchin is a former UCLA Bruin
- Utah Talons = first back-to-back AUSL champions in league history
- Head coach: Cindy Ball-Malone (first coach to win back-to-back AUSL titles)
- Venue: Davis Diamond, Texas A&M, College Station, TX
**Sources:** theausl.com, kutv.com/news/local/utah-talons-sweep-chicago, uclabruins.com, mlb.com ("'It was art, really': Fouts leads Talons to 2nd straight AUSL championship"), kbtx.com

research.facts:
Isa Torres Transfers to Texas
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Florida State senior shortstop/infielder Isa Torres signed with Texas on June 18, 2026
- Torres was named D1Softball's 2026 National Player of the Year
- 2026 stats at FSU: .530 BA (3rd nationally), 16 HR, 56 RBI, 78 runs scored
- Set FSU single-season records: BA (.530), runs (78), slugging (.978), OBP (.591)
- FSU fielding %: .989 at SS
- Awards: NFCA 1st-Team All-American, NFCA Gold Glove, ACC Player of the Year, ACC Defensive Player of the Year
- Native of Georgetown, TX
- Texas is the 2026 NCAA national champion (beat Texas Tech in WCWS finals, May 28–June 5, Devon Park, Oklahoma City)
- Also joining Texas: former Arizona State C Samantha Swan, former Texas Tech LHP Samantha Lincoln
- Also joining Texas: Anneca Anderson (pitcher/North Texas), Cam Harrison (pitcher-OF/Arkansas), Tia Milloy (utility/Oklahoma), Kylee Magee (pitcher/Nebraska)
**Sources:** texaslonghorns.com (June 18, 2026), 247sports.com ("Texas lands D1Softball's 2026 National Player of the Year Isa Torres"), d1softball.com

research.facts:
AUSL 2026 Season by the Numbers
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- 181% viewership increase over 2025 season
- 404,000 viewers on June 21 (OKC Spark vs. Portland Cascade) — AUSL single-game viewership record
- Game 1 Championship (July 25) on ABC — first professional softball game ever broadcast on network TV
- Montana Fouts set four AUSL single-season records: IP (62.1), Ks (63), wins (7), complete games (7)
- Maya Brady (OKC Spark): 11 HR in 2026, setting AUSL single-season HR record (set in elimination loss; previous record was 9, set by Zerkle in 2025)
- Jadelyn Allchin named Championship Series MVP
- Utah Talons: first back-to-back AUSL champions
- Utah coach Cindy Ball-Malone: first coach to win back-to-back AUSL titles
- League in third season starting 2027
- Chris Sale (2026 ERA: 2.19, third-best in MLB) — not softball, disregard
**Sources:** mlb.com, espn.com, theausl.com, oursportscentral.com, kutv.com
